### Devotional: Isaiah 31
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deuteronomy-3-psalm-85-isaiah-31-revelation1/
Passage: Isaiah 31:1-9
Points:
- Trusting in worldly military might and alliances rather than seeking the Lord invites divine judgment.
- God reveals both fierce combat power like a roaring lion and tender defense like hovering birds to protect Zion.
- Experiencing God's blessing requires total repentance, abandoning all idols rather than offering selective or partial loyalty.
- Deliverance comes through God's supernatural power rather than mortal human weapons.
- The historical judgment on Assyria foreshadows God's ultimate victory over all enemies and the establishment of His reign.
